statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis codes are I34.0 and R42
CPT code 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
